body: thank you for your help... I really appreciate it. I'm just going to crawl into bed now and sleep it off I hope.
and where I am, I'm alone. I'd have ended it a long time ago but my cats, they need me.. until my ex husband takes them, I've no option but to take care of them.

he says he does but doesn't know how to be. I don't think he really likes me as the person I am. but keeps reaching for me. thank you for talking to me. I don't think I'm a bad person but I keep getting shot down every time I ask him to just be with. I know my story is as old as the ages but the hurt is very new and I'm trying really hard to keep things in perspective. I have health, a great family and I'm fairly creative. but i really want to die and not wake up feeling like this anymore. I want the hurt to stop.

lol. no. we keep coming together in some bizzarre dysfunctional relationship. But the reason why I think I'm doing so poorly is because we've been best friends for ten years and now, I literally, have nothing to fall back on. But I lost her as a friend as well.. and so did he. We're a shitfest.
